subject: Conditional invoice-only onboarding / temporary allowlist for IntegrateK
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@integratek.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <mreed@integratek.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding ask: pilot start without PO?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We're preparing for the two-week pilot and would like to start provisioning next Monday. Our procurement is a bit slow — is there any way to kick off onboarding and usage on an invoice-only basis while we complete a PO on our side?

I've attached our onboarding packet (company profile, W9, basic SLAs). If there's an evidence checklist or temporary exceptions form you need from us, point me to it and we'll return it today.

High level: pilot estimated spend ~ $3k for the first 30 days. If this helps, Marcus is copied to confirm timing.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships | IntegrateK
elena@integratek.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: integratek_onboarding_packet.pdf (pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@integratek.com>, Marcus Reed <mreed@integratek.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding ask: pilot start without PO?

Elena — thanks for the packet and quick turnaround. Short answer: we can typically allow a temporary invoice-only path for small pilots, provided a few procurement conditions are met. I'm looping in Laura from Procurements and Priyom from Sales Ops to confirm the exact evidence we need and the approval path.

Our suggested conditional approach:
- Invoice-only start for up to $5,000 total spend during a 30-day pilot window.
- Required evidence returned before provisioning: W9, certificate of insurance (COI) with vendor liability, and signed onboarding acceptance form (we'll provide).
- IntegrateK to acknowledge that a PO is expected within 30 days if piloted spend exceeds $5k; otherwise invoices will be accepted and paid on standard terms.
- Redwood retains right to pause provisioning if evidence isn't provided within 48 hours of first usage.

Laura / Priyom / Karthik — can you confirm: 1) any additional procurement redlines we need for an exception; 2) whether we need an internal approval record (Procure ticket or e-form) to document this temporary waiver. If you prefer, I can open the Procure ticket with the details.

Elena — attaching our minimal onboarding acceptance form to speed things up. If acceptable I'll start provisioning once we have the signed form + COI.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0098

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_acceptance_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena@integratek.com>, Marcus Reed <mreed@integratek.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Apr 2028 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding ask: pilot start without PO?

Hannah / team — here's procurement's conditional approval language and required evidence. I'm copying the wording we need stored in the internal approval (Procure ticket). If you want me to create the ticket I will.

Procurement conditional waiver (internal summary):
- Eligible: New vendor pilots with forecasted 30-day spend <= $5,000 and one-off trials.
- Evidence required before provisioning:
  - Completed W9 (received)
  - COI showing general liability >= $1M and naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (we can accept pending COI if cert states insurer is processing; full COI to arrive within 7 days).
  - Signed onboarding acceptance form (minimal T&Cs; no commercial redlines).
  - Vendor bank/payment remittance details for invoicing.
- Duration: temporary invoice-only for maximum 30 days. If total billed amount is expected to exceed $5k we'll require PO issuance and no further provisioning beyond the $5k threshold until PO is in place.
- Exceptions / escalations: Anything that puts customer data on-premise or requires enhanced security posture (VPC, on-prem deployment, HSM) is not eligible for invoice-only onboarding.

Attachments: redwood_procurement_conditions.pdf (pdf) — this contains the formal wording we need to store in the Procure ticket and the approval that Finance will sign.

Action items: Hannah — please confirm IntegrateK agrees to the above and upload COI + signed form. Priyom — can you create the Procure ticket (PROC-INTK-2028-09) with the above summary and queue for Finance sign-off? Karthik — FYI for any commercial limits.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0220

Thanks everyone — the conditional approach looks fine to us and we can return the signed onboarding acceptance form by EOD today. A couple quick points:
- COI: our broker can issue the COI tomorrow morning; I will email a pending confirmation by EOB and the full COI within 5 business days.
- Spend: agreed — we will cap the pilot to $5k. If usage trends above that we'll coordinate the PO and notify you before reaching the threshold.
- Payment terms: standard 30 days on invoice is fine.

Hannah — please go ahead with provisioning once you have the signed form + COI confirmation email. Priyom — let us know the Procure ticket id when created so we can reference it internally.

Appreciate the flexibility — excited to get started.

Best,
